			RRB NTPC 10+2 Level Recruitment 2025 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

			Exam Pattern

			**1. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 1:

			
				
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 100
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 40 Questions
					Mathematics: 30 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 30 Questions
					Total Marks: 100
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**2. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 2:

			
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 120
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
					Specific to Post (subject-specific questions)
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 50 Questions
					Mathematics: 35 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 35 Questions
					Total Marks: 120
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**3. Skill Test (if applicable):

			
				Type: Depending on the post, this may include typing tests, computer-based tests, or other specific skill assessments.
			

			**4. Document Verification:

			
				Candidates who clear the CBT and Skill Test (if applicable) will undergo document verification to validate their eligibility and credentials.
			

			Syllabus

			**1. General Awareness:

			
				Current Affairs (National and International)
				Indian History and Culture
				Geography
				Indian Polity and Constitution
				Economy
				General Science
				Environmental Issues
			

			**2. Mathematics:

			
				Number Systems
				Algebra
				Geometry
				Trigonometry
				Mensuration
				Arithmetic (Percentage, Profit and Loss, Simple and Compound Interest, Ratio and Proportion)
			

			**3. General Intelligence and Reasoning:

			
				Analogies
				Blood Relations
				Coding-Decoding
				Syllogism
				Direction Sense
				Decision Making
				Non-Verbal Reasoning (Series, Patterns)
			

			**4. Post-Specific Syllabus (for Stage 2):

			
				Depending on the specific NTPC post applied for, there might be additional subject-specific questions in CBT Stage 2. This could include questions related to the job profile and technical skills relevant to the position.
			

			Preparation Tips:

			
				Study Regularly: Follow a structured study plan covering all sections.
				Practice Mock Tests: Familiarize yourself with the exam format and time management.
				Stay Updated: Read newspapers and current affairs magazines to enhance your General Awareness.
				Review Previous Papers: Practice previous years' question papers to understand the exam pattern and question types.

			RRB NTPC 10+2 Level Recruitment 2025 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

			Exam Pattern

			**1. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 1:

			
				
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 100
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 40 Questions
					Mathematics: 30 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 30 Questions
					Total Marks: 100
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**2. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 2:

			
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 120
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
					Specific to Post (subject-specific questions)
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 50 Questions
					Mathematics: 35 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 35 Questions
					Total Marks: 120
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**3. Skill Test (if applicable):

			
				Type: Depending on the post, this may include typing tests, computer-based tests, or other specific skill assessments.
			

			**4. Document Verification:

			
				Candidates who clear the CBT and Skill Test (if applicable) will undergo document verification to validate their eligibility and credentials.
			

			Syllabus

			**1. General Awareness:

			
				Current Affairs (National and International)
				Indian History and Culture
				Geography
				Indian Polity and Constitution
				Economy
				General Science
				Environmental Issues
			

			**2. Mathematics:

			
				Number Systems
				Algebra
				Geometry
				Trigonometry
				Mensuration
				Arithmetic (Percentage, Profit and Loss, Simple and Compound Interest, Ratio and Proportion)
			

			**3. General Intelligence and Reasoning:

			
				Analogies
				Blood Relations
				Coding-Decoding
				Syllogism
				Direction Sense
				Decision Making
				Non-Verbal Reasoning (Series, Patterns)
			

			**4. Post-Specific Syllabus (for Stage 2):

			
				Depending on the specific NTPC post applied for, there might be additional subject-specific questions in CBT Stage 2. This could include questions related to the job profile and technical skills relevant to the position.
			

			Preparation Tips:

			
				Study Regularly: Follow a structured study plan covering all sections.
				Practice Mock Tests: Familiarize yourself with the exam format and time management.
				Stay Updated: Read newspapers and current affairs magazines to enhance your General Awareness.
				Review Previous Papers: Practice previous years' question papers to understand the exam pattern and question types.

			RRB NTPC 10+2 Level Recruitment 2025 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

			Exam Pattern

			**1. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 1:

			
				
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 100
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 40 Questions
					Mathematics: 30 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 30 Questions
					Total Marks: 100
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**2. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 2:

			
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 120
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
					Specific to Post (subject-specific questions)
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 50 Questions
					Mathematics: 35 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 35 Questions
					Total Marks: 120
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**3. Skill Test (if applicable):

			
				Type: Depending on the post, this may include typing tests, computer-based tests, or other specific skill assessments.
			

			**4. Document Verification:

			
				Candidates who clear the CBT and Skill Test (if applicable) will undergo document verification to validate their eligibility and credentials.
			

			Syllabus

			**1. General Awareness:

			
				Current Affairs (National and International)
				Indian History and Culture
				Geography
				Indian Polity and Constitution
				Economy
				General Science
				Environmental Issues
			

			**2. Mathematics:

			
				Number Systems
				Algebra
				Geometry
				Trigonometry
				Mensuration
				Arithmetic (Percentage, Profit and Loss, Simple and Compound Interest, Ratio and Proportion)
			

			**3. General Intelligence and Reasoning:

			
				Analogies
				Blood Relations
				Coding-Decoding
				Syllogism
				Direction Sense
				Decision Making
				Non-Verbal Reasoning (Series, Patterns)
			

			**4. Post-Specific Syllabus (for Stage 2):

			
				Depending on the specific NTPC post applied for, there might be additional subject-specific questions in CBT Stage 2. This could include questions related to the job profile and technical skills relevant to the position.
			

			Preparation Tips:

			
				Study Regularly: Follow a structured study plan covering all sections.
				Practice Mock Tests: Familiarize yourself with the exam format and time management.
				Stay Updated: Read newspapers and current affairs magazines to enhance your General Awareness.
				Review Previous Papers: Practice previous years' question papers to understand the exam pattern and question types.

			RRB NTPC 10+2 Level Recruitment 2025 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

			Exam Pattern

			**1. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 1:

			
				
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 100
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 40 Questions
					Mathematics: 30 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 30 Questions
					Total Marks: 100
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**2. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 2:

			
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 120
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
					Specific to Post (subject-specific questions)
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 50 Questions
					Mathematics: 35 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 35 Questions
					Total Marks: 120
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**3. Skill Test (if applicable):

			
				Type: Depending on the post, this may include typing tests, computer-based tests, or other specific skill assessments.
			

			**4. Document Verification:

			
				Candidates who clear the CBT and Skill Test (if applicable) will undergo document verification to validate their eligibility and credentials.
			

			Syllabus

			**1. General Awareness:

			
				Current Affairs (National and International)
				Indian History and Culture
				Geography
				Indian Polity and Constitution
				Economy
				General Science
				Environmental Issues
			

			**2. Mathematics:

			
				Number Systems
				Algebra
				Geometry
				Trigonometry
				Mensuration
				Arithmetic (Percentage, Profit and Loss, Simple and Compound Interest, Ratio and Proportion)
			

			**3. General Intelligence and Reasoning:

			
				Analogies
				Blood Relations
				Coding-Decoding
				Syllogism
				Direction Sense
				Decision Making
				Non-Verbal Reasoning (Series, Patterns)
			

			**4. Post-Specific Syllabus (for Stage 2):

			
				Depending on the specific NTPC post applied for, there might be additional subject-specific questions in CBT Stage 2. This could include questions related to the job profile and technical skills relevant to the position.
			

			Preparation Tips:

			
				Study Regularly: Follow a structured study plan covering all sections.
				Practice Mock Tests: Familiarize yourself with the exam format and time management.
				Stay Updated: Read newspapers and current affairs magazines to enhance your General Awareness.
				Review Previous Papers: Practice previous years' question papers to understand the exam pattern and question types.

			RRB NTPC 10+2 Level Recruitment 2025 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

			Exam Pattern

			**1. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 1:

			
				
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 100
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 40 Questions
					Mathematics: 30 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 30 Questions
					Total Marks: 100
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**2. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 2:

			
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 120
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
					Specific to Post (subject-specific questions)
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 50 Questions
					Mathematics: 35 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 35 Questions
					Total Marks: 120
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**3. Skill Test (if applicable):

			
				Type: Depending on the post, this may include typing tests, computer-based tests, or other specific skill assessments.
			

			**4. Document Verification:

			
				Candidates who clear the CBT and Skill Test (if applicable) will undergo document verification to validate their eligibility and credentials.
			

			Syllabus

			**1. General Awareness:

			
				Current Affairs (National and International)
				Indian History and Culture
				Geography
				Indian Polity and Constitution
				Economy
				General Science
				Environmental Issues
			

			**2. Mathematics:

			
				Number Systems
				Algebra
				Geometry
				Trigonometry
				Mensuration
				Arithmetic (Percentage, Profit and Loss, Simple and Compound Interest, Ratio and Proportion)
			

			**3. General Intelligence and Reasoning:

			
				Analogies
				Blood Relations
				Coding-Decoding
				Syllogism
				Direction Sense
				Decision Making
				Non-Verbal Reasoning (Series, Patterns)
			

			**4. Post-Specific Syllabus (for Stage 2):

			
				Depending on the specific NTPC post applied for, there might be additional subject-specific questions in CBT Stage 2. This could include questions related to the job profile and technical skills relevant to the position.
			

			Preparation Tips:

			
				Study Regularly: Follow a structured study plan covering all sections.
				Practice Mock Tests: Familiarize yourself with the exam format and time management.
				Stay Updated: Read newspapers and current affairs magazines to enhance your General Awareness.
				Review Previous Papers: Practice previous years' question papers to understand the exam pattern and question types.

				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 120

				Environmental Issues
			

			**2. Mathematics:

			
				Number Systems
				Algebra
				Geometry
				Trigonometry
				Mensuration
				Arithmetic (Percentage, Profit and Loss, Simple and Compound Interest, Ratio and Proportion)

				Environmental Issues

				Number Systems
				Algebra
				Geometry
				Trigonometry
				Mensuration
				Arithmetic (Percentage, Profit and Loss, Simple and Compound Interest, Ratio and Proportion)

				Direction Sense

			RRB NTPC 10+2 Level Recruitment 2025 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

			Exam Pattern

			**1. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 1:

			
				
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 100
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 40 Questions
					Mathematics: 30 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 30 Questions
					Total Marks: 100
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**2. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 2:

			
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 120
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
					Specific to Post (subject-specific questions)
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 50 Questions
					Mathematics: 35 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 35 Questions
					Total Marks: 120
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**3. Skill Test (if applicable):

			
				Type: Depending on the post, this may include typing tests, computer-based tests, or other specific skill assessments.
			

			**4. Document Verification:

			
				Candidates who clear the CBT and Skill Test (if applicable) will undergo document verification to validate their eligibility and credentials.
			

			Syllabus

			**1. General Awareness:

			
				Current Affairs (National and International)
				Indian History and Culture
				Geography
				Indian Polity and Constitution
				Economy
				General Science
				Environmental Issues
			

			**2. Mathematics:

			
				Number Systems
				Algebra
				Geometry
				Trigonometry
				Mensuration
				Arithmetic (Percentage, Profit and Loss, Simple and Compound Interest, Ratio and Proportion)
			

			**3. General Intelligence and Reasoning:

			
				Analogies
				Blood Relations
				Coding-Decoding
				Syllogism
				Direction Sense
				Decision Making
				Non-Verbal Reasoning (Series, Patterns)
			

			**4. Post-Specific Syllabus (for Stage 2):

			
				Depending on the specific NTPC post applied for, there might be additional subject-specific questions in CBT Stage 2. This could include questions related to the job profile and technical skills relevant to the position.
			

			Preparation Tips:

			
				Study Regularly: Follow a structured study plan covering all sections.
				Practice Mock Tests: Familiarize yourself with the exam format and time management.
				Stay Updated: Read newspapers and current affairs magazines to enhance your General Awareness.
				Review Previous Papers: Practice previous years' question papers to understand the exam pattern and question types.

			RRB NTPC 10+2 Level Recruitment 2025 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

			Exam Pattern

			**1. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 1:

			
				
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 100
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 40 Questions
					Mathematics: 30 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 30 Questions
					Total Marks: 100
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**2. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 2:

			
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 120
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
					Specific to Post (subject-specific questions)
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 50 Questions
					Mathematics: 35 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 35 Questions
					Total Marks: 120
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**3. Skill Test (if applicable):

			
				Type: Depending on the post, this may include typing tests, computer-based tests, or other specific skill assessments.
			

			**4. Document Verification:

			
				Candidates who clear the CBT and Skill Test (if applicable) will undergo document verification to validate their eligibility and credentials.
			

			Syllabus

			**1. General Awareness:

			
				Current Affairs (National and International)
				Indian History and Culture
				Geography
				Indian Polity and Constitution
				Economy
				General Science
				Environmental Issues
			

			**2. Mathematics:

			
				Number Systems
				Algebra
				Geometry
				Trigonometry
				Mensuration
				Arithmetic (Percentage, Profit and Loss, Simple and Compound Interest, Ratio and Proportion)
			

			**3. General Intelligence and Reasoning:

			
				Analogies
				Blood Relations
				Coding-Decoding
				Syllogism
				Direction Sense
				Decision Making
				Non-Verbal Reasoning (Series, Patterns)
			

			**4. Post-Specific Syllabus (for Stage 2):

			
				Depending on the specific NTPC post applied for, there might be additional subject-specific questions in CBT Stage 2. This could include questions related to the job profile and technical skills relevant to the position.
			

			Preparation Tips:

			
				Study Regularly: Follow a structured study plan covering all sections.
				Practice Mock Tests: Familiarize yourself with the exam format and time management.
				Stay Updated: Read newspapers and current affairs magazines to enhance your General Awareness.
				Review Previous Papers: Practice previous years' question papers to understand the exam pattern and question types.

			RRB NTPC 10+2 Level Recruitment 2025 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

			Exam Pattern

			**1. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 1:

			
				
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 100
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 40 Questions
					Mathematics: 30 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 30 Questions
					Total Marks: 100
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**2. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 2:

			
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 120
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
					Specific to Post (subject-specific questions)
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 50 Questions
					Mathematics: 35 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 35 Questions
					Total Marks: 120
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**3. Skill Test (if applicable):

			
				Type: Depending on the post, this may include typing tests, computer-based tests, or other specific skill assessments.
			

			**4. Document Verification:

			
				Candidates who clear the CBT and Skill Test (if applicable) will undergo document verification to validate their eligibility and credentials.
			

			Syllabus

			**1. General Awareness:

			
				Current Affairs (National and International)
				Indian History and Culture
				Geography
				Indian Polity and Constitution
				Economy
				General Science
				Environmental Issues
			

			**2. Mathematics:

			
				Number Systems
				Algebra
				Geometry
				Trigonometry
				Mensuration
				Arithmetic (Percentage, Profit and Loss, Simple and Compound Interest, Ratio and Proportion)
			

			**3. General Intelligence and Reasoning:

			
				Analogies
				Blood Relations
				Coding-Decoding
				Syllogism
				Direction Sense
				Decision Making
				Non-Verbal Reasoning (Series, Patterns)
			

			**4. Post-Specific Syllabus (for Stage 2):

			
				Depending on the specific NTPC post applied for, there might be additional subject-specific questions in CBT Stage 2. This could include questions related to the job profile and technical skills relevant to the position.
			

			Preparation Tips:

			
				Study Regularly: Follow a structured study plan covering all sections.
				Practice Mock Tests: Familiarize yourself with the exam format and time management.
				Stay Updated: Read newspapers and current affairs magazines to enhance your General Awareness.
				Review Previous Papers: Practice previous years' question papers to understand the exam pattern and question types.

			RRB NTPC 10+2 Level Recruitment 2025 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

			Exam Pattern

			**1. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 1:

			
				
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 100
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 40 Questions
					Mathematics: 30 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 30 Questions
					Total Marks: 100
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**2. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 2:

			
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 120
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
					Specific to Post (subject-specific questions)
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 50 Questions
					Mathematics: 35 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 35 Questions
					Total Marks: 120
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**3. Skill Test (if applicable):

			
				Type: Depending on the post, this may include typing tests, computer-based tests, or other specific skill assessments.
			

			**4. Document Verification:

			
				Candidates who clear the CBT and Skill Test (if applicable) will undergo document verification to validate their eligibility and credentials.
			

			Syllabus

			**1. General Awareness:

			
				Current Affairs (National and International)
				Indian History and Culture
				Geography
				Indian Polity and Constitution
				Economy
				General Science
				Environmental Issues
			

			**2. Mathematics:

			
				Number Systems
				Algebra
				Geometry
				Trigonometry
				Mensuration
				Arithmetic (Percentage, Profit and Loss, Simple and Compound Interest, Ratio and Proportion)
			

			**3. General Intelligence and Reasoning:

			
				Analogies
				Blood Relations
				Coding-Decoding
				Syllogism
				Direction Sense
				Decision Making
				Non-Verbal Reasoning (Series, Patterns)
			

			**4. Post-Specific Syllabus (for Stage 2):

			
				Depending on the specific NTPC post applied for, there might be additional subject-specific questions in CBT Stage 2. This could include questions related to the job profile and technical skills relevant to the position.
			

			Preparation Tips:

			
				Study Regularly: Follow a structured study plan covering all sections.
				Practice Mock Tests: Familiarize yourself with the exam format and time management.
				Stay Updated: Read newspapers and current affairs magazines to enhance your General Awareness.
				Review Previous Papers: Practice previous years' question papers to understand the exam pattern and question types.

			RRB NTPC 10+2 Level Recruitment 2025 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

			Exam Pattern

			**1. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 1:

			
				
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 100
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 40 Questions
					Mathematics: 30 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 30 Questions
					Total Marks: 100
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**2. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 2:

			
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 120
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
					Specific to Post (subject-specific questions)
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 50 Questions
					Mathematics: 35 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 35 Questions
					Total Marks: 120
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**3. Skill Test (if applicable):

			
				Type: Depending on the post, this may include typing tests, computer-based tests, or other specific skill assessments.
			

			**4. Document Verification:

			
				Candidates who clear the CBT and Skill Test (if applicable) will undergo document verification to validate their eligibility and credentials.
			

			Syllabus

			**1. General Awareness:

			
				Current Affairs (National and International)
				Indian History and Culture
				Geography
				Indian Polity and Constitution
				Economy
				General Science
				Environmental Issues
			

			**2. Mathematics:

			
				Number Systems
				Algebra
				Geometry
				Trigonometry
				Mensuration
				Arithmetic (Percentage, Profit and Loss, Simple and Compound Interest, Ratio and Proportion)
			

			**3. General Intelligence and Reasoning:

			
				Analogies
				Blood Relations
				Coding-Decoding
				Syllogism
				Direction Sense
				Decision Making
				Non-Verbal Reasoning (Series, Patterns)
			

			**4. Post-Specific Syllabus (for Stage 2):

			
				Depending on the specific NTPC post applied for, there might be additional subject-specific questions in CBT Stage 2. This could include questions related to the job profile and technical skills relevant to the position.
			

			Preparation Tips:

			
				Study Regularly: Follow a structured study plan covering all sections.
				Practice Mock Tests: Familiarize yourself with the exam format and time management.
				Stay Updated: Read newspapers and current affairs magazines to enhance your General Awareness.
				Review Previous Papers: Practice previous years' question papers to understand the exam pattern and question types.

			RRB NTPC 10+2 Level Recruitment 2025 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

			Exam Pattern

			**1. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 1:

			
				
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 100
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 40 Questions
					Mathematics: 30 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 30 Questions
					Total Marks: 100
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**2. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 2:

			
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 120
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
					Specific to Post (subject-specific questions)
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 50 Questions
					Mathematics: 35 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 35 Questions
					Total Marks: 120
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**3. Skill Test (if applicable):

			
				Type: Depending on the post, this may include typing tests, computer-based tests, or other specific skill assessments.
			

			**4. Document Verification:

			
				Candidates who clear the CBT and Skill Test (if applicable) will undergo document verification to validate their eligibility and credentials.
			

			Syllabus

			**1. General Awareness:

			
				Current Affairs (National and International)
				Indian History and Culture
				Geography
				Indian Polity and Constitution
				Economy
				General Science
				Environmental Issues
			

			**2. Mathematics:

			
				Number Systems
				Algebra
				Geometry
				Trigonometry
				Mensuration
				Arithmetic (Percentage, Profit and Loss, Simple and Compound Interest, Ratio and Proportion)
			

			**3. General Intelligence and Reasoning:

			
				Analogies
				Blood Relations
				Coding-Decoding
				Syllogism
				Direction Sense
				Decision Making
				Non-Verbal Reasoning (Series, Patterns)
			

			**4. Post-Specific Syllabus (for Stage 2):

			
				Depending on the specific NTPC post applied for, there might be additional subject-specific questions in CBT Stage 2. This could include questions related to the job profile and technical skills relevant to the position.
			

			Preparation Tips:

			
				Study Regularly: Follow a structured study plan covering all sections.
				Practice Mock Tests: Familiarize yourself with the exam format and time management.
				Stay Updated: Read newspapers and current affairs magazines to enhance your General Awareness.
				Review Previous Papers: Practice previous years' question papers to understand the exam pattern and question types.

			RRB NTPC 10+2 Level Recruitment 2025 Exam Pattern / Syllabus

			Exam Pattern

			**1. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 1:

			
				
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 100
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 40 Questions
					Mathematics: 30 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 30 Questions
					Total Marks: 100
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**2. Computer-Based Test (CBT) Stage 2:

			
				Type: Objective Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
				Duration: 90 minutes
				Number of Questions: 120
				Sections:
				
					General Awareness
					Mathematics
					General Intelligence and Reasoning
					Specific to Post (subject-specific questions)
				
				
				Marking Scheme:
				
					General Awareness: 50 Questions
					Mathematics: 35 Questions
					General Intelligence and Reasoning: 35 Questions
					Total Marks: 120
					Negative Marking: 1/3 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
				
				
			

			**3. Skill Test (if applicable):

			
				Type: Depending on the post, this may include typing tests, computer-based tests, or other specific skill assessments.
			

			**4. Document Verification:

			
				Candidates who clear the CBT and Skill Test (if applicable) will undergo document verification to validate their eligibility and credentials.
			

			Syllabus

			**1. General Awareness:

			
				Current Affairs (National and International)
				Indian History and Culture
				Geography
				Indian Polity and Constitution
				Economy
				General Science
				Environmental Issues
			

			**2. Mathematics:

			
				Number Systems
				Algebra
				Geometry
				Trigonometry
				Mensuration
				Arithmetic (Percentage, Profit and Loss, Simple and Compound Interest, Ratio and Proportion)
			

			**3. General Intelligence and Reasoning:

			
				Analogies
				Blood Relations
				Coding-Decoding
				Syllogism
				Direction Sense
				Decision Making
				Non-Verbal Reasoning (Series, Patterns)
			

			**4. Post-Specific Syllabus (for Stage 2):

			
				Depending on the specific NTPC post applied for, there might be additional subject-specific questions in CBT Stage 2. This could include questions related to the job profile and technical skills relevant to the position.
			

			Preparation Tips:

			
				Study Regularly: Follow a structured study plan covering all sections.
				Practice Mock Tests: Familiarize yourself with the exam format and time management.
				Stay Updated: Read newspapers and current affairs magazines to enhance your General Awareness.
				Review Previous Papers: Practice previous years' question papers to understand the exam pattern and question types.
